### How can I optimize my process using the process model? {#sec-pmd-53}

[**Detailed Information on Process Optimization**]{#sec-pmd-53-detailed}

Process optimization using models fit to data collected using response surface designs<!-- XREF: PRI Chapter 5, Process Improvement, response surface designs, not yet migrated to this book; source handbook/pri/section3/pri336.htm --> is primarily covered in Section 5.5.3<!-- XREF: PRI Chapter 5, Process Improvement, optimizing a process, not yet migrated to this book; source handbook/pri/section5/pri53.htm --> of Chapter 5: Process Improvement.<!-- XREF: PRI Chapter 5, Process Improvement, not yet migrated to this book; source handbook/pri/pri.htm --> In that section detailed information is given on how to determine the correct process inputs to hit a target output value or to maximize or minimize process output. Some background on the use of process models for optimization can be found in [Section 4.1.3.4](#sec-pmd-134) of this chapter, however, and information on the basic analysis of data from optimization experiments is covered along with that of other types of models in [Section 4.1](#sec-pmd-1) through [Section 4.4](#sec-pmd-4) of this chapter.
